nodes.label: AUTOL route-selection mode
nodes.description: AUTOL is script mode, default on globals/LOAD CFG, resolved per submission without changing orderRoute. Final rounded/offset limit versus opposite quote predicts adding ARCA1L or taking fee bands: BESTL $1+, SMRTL sub-$1 if price*0.0036>0.0015, BESTL otherwise/equality. Taking uses opposite quote; FREE1L manual only. Urgent GTFO/hijack BESTL; STOP remains STOP.

nodes.label: Generation, direction and revision protect TP lifecycle
nodes.description: Account/symbol alert names and payload account, symbol, generation, direction and revision bind TP execution. Submission consumes revision. Reset/replacement stales old payloads; deferred alerts retain side/revision; a completed short TP stays consumed until RESET or additional fills change size/average.
nodes.norm_label: generation, direction and revision protect tp lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Stale or deferred alerts must not act on another trade, side or reset revision.

nodes.label: Trade identity is account plus symbol
nodes.description: Account/symbol is immutable trade identity. All cancellations, timers, protection and alerts stay with that context across montage/account switches. A short in another symbol can coexist with an automated long; a buy cannot reduce a same-symbol short/pending short action.
nodes.norm_label: trade identity is account plus symbol

nodes.label: Automatic protection for actual short fills
nodes.description: All sixteen short-entry hotkeys start enabled stop and TP protection after actual fills. Short monitoring is timer-based independent of useTimerArming; first partial is protected, later fills/average changes resize after cancellation acknowledgment. Covers/new short entries suspend protection until BUY completion/cancellation. Stops off disables automatic stop rearming; manual RESET and independent TP remain available.
nodes.norm_label: automatic protection for actual short fills

nodes.label: Four configurable entry tiers and quantity multiplier
nodes.description: Base shares are MIB=100, IB=200, legacy buy_25=300, legacy buy_50=500, multiplied by $qtyMult (default 1.0) and rounded whole. Presets 0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0/3.0 recalculate maxPositionSize from scaled Tier 4.
nodes.norm_label: four configurable entry tiers and quantity multiplier

nodes.label: Unbound internal helpers remain in canonical map
nodes.description: Blank key fields retain named callable helpers for guards, no-stop cancel, scale BE, TP execution, hijack, timers, working-order checks and trade/context cleanup/read/action/route resolution. Complete-map compilation is needed even when helper has no keyboard shortcut.
nodes.norm_label: unbound internal helpers remain in canonical map
nodes.rationale: These scripts are invoked internally by name and must be installed with public actions.

nodes.label: Independent signed Bid and Ask entry offsets
nodes.description: Both buy and short offset entries use selected quote plus signed entryAskOffset/entryBidOffset. Negative values price below; positive values above. Defaults ASK=-0.01, BID=+0.01. ASK±/BID± labels on buy page 2 and short page 4; selectors only on page 5, same five choices in both profiles.
nodes.norm_label: independent signed bid and ask entry offsets

nodes.label: Entry spread, slippage, size and risk guards
nodes.description: Buy guards check spread relative to fixed R, stop-to-Bid slippage margin, max total size, projected total planned-stop risk, profitable-only scale-in, rehab, duplicate pending and single tracked long per account. Short entries bypass long entry guards.
nodes.norm_label: entry spread, slippage, size and risk guards

nodes.label: Proposed time-window trading lock
nodes.description: Candidate only: Timer Event updates central TRADE_OK via GetSecond and hardcoded session boundaries to block entries outside windows.
nodes.rationale: The TODO states DAS exposes seconds since midnight rather than native date/clock objects.

nodes.label: Proposed session profit giveback lock
nodes.description: Candidate only: internally track session P&L/peak with globals and intent; after profit target, >=50% peak giveback locks entries, allows exits and never auto-resets same day in live.
nodes.rationale: The TODO states script-safe realized P&L is unavailable, so proposed tracking must use globals.

nodes.label: Proposed pre-trade dollar exposure guard
nodes.description: Candidate only: pre-send cap shares*price, optionally add existing abs(shares)*Last. Document states DAS lacks native position-value field but hotkeys can compute exposure.

nodes.label: Proposed loss-streak and cooldown guard
nodes.description: Candidate only: stop-intent tagging increments loss streak only for armed-stop hits; ignore discretionary/scratch exits. Time/session cooldown blocks entries but always permits exits.
nodes.rationale: DAS cannot natively distinguish stop exits from manual exits; intent-based tracking is required.

nodes.label: Documented account, montage and timer setup
nodes.description: Canonical scripts/keymap can compile or be copied; timer and chart scripts install manually. Primary_OE/Primary_Chart names, outputPath, account substitution settings and optionally failOnMissing are required setup concerns. Desktop Load can ExecHotKey Set Global Variables; complete upgrades recreate TP alerts/remove retired backstop map/alerts.
nodes.norm_label: documented account, montage and timer setup

nodes.label: BESTL AUTOL band and SMRTL identifier corrections
nodes.description: Current AUTOL $1+ uses BESTL after FREE1 cancellations; FREE1L manual only, no fallback/retry. SMRT identifier corrected to SMRTL and its key preserved. Globals default AUTOL; urgent exits BESTL; older feature prose retains superseded route/offset history.
nodes.norm_label: bestl autol band and smrtl identifier corrections

nodes.label: Supplied baseline exit-coordinator rollback
nodes.description: Current restore of Hotkey-20261015-062456.htk removes overlap coordinator/recovery that blocked manual exits after rejected NewOrder templates; retains baseline .50 stop, public bindings, prior page/performance work, and RefNum>=nextReference initialization correction. Repeated exits retain overlap risk.

nodes.label: Client-side R-target take-profit alerts
nodes.description: DAS client price alert at Avg +/- R*takeProfitFactor, requiring Last beyond target and positive/profitable rounded target. RESET works with toggle off; short automatic TP can operate without stops. Executor cancels relevant side, reduces default 50% at Bid (long) or Ask (short), then timer confirms fills/cancellation and restores fixed or BE protection. DAS/timer/data must remain running.

nodes.label: Timer-based long entry protection staging
nodes.description: Default useTimerArming=1 returns after buy send. Clean fresh actual fill arms stop/TP at first timer tick; working SELLs and scale-ins cancel then protect on another tick. Retry missing average data, resize later fills, and cancel unfilled entries at entryMaxTicks.
nodes.rationale: Actual fills and valid average cost prevent protection against nonexistent or changing positions.

nodes.label: Optional oversized-position emergency exit and lock
nodes.description: Disabled by default; enabled checks Primary_OE size against maxPositionSize in LIVE and opted-in SIM. Native Reverse exits long at Bid-exitOffset or short at Ask+exitOffset, locks montage buttons and sets HIJACKED_LOCKED. Script lock clears on restart/globals/explicit reset; montage unlock stays manual.
nodes.norm_label: optional oversized-position emergency exit and lock

nodes.label: Documented compilation and installation workflow
nodes.description: Documented operator workflow builds output.htk from keymap.yaml, loads the full hotkey file, separately replaces the complete Timer Event Script and initializes globals. Retired backstop bindings/alerts must be removed; legacy TP alerts recreated.
nodes.rationale: The installed timer and complete internal hotkey map must match the source upgrade.

nodes.label: Entry offsets and exit cushions are independent
nodes.description: Entry selectors change only entryAskOffset/entryBidOffset shared by buys/shorts. exitOffset separately sets ordinary exit desired cushion plus uncapped stop/hijack offset. Ordinary percentage cap and GTFO independent percentage cap remain separate; signed-entry correction does not change plain entries, exits or resolver.
nodes.norm_label: entry offsets and exit cushions are independent

nodes.label: Restored exit paths retain overlap risk
nodes.description: Exit coordinator rollback restores pre-coordinator sell/cover paths. Rapid repeated exits can overlap; cancellation settling waits do not prove broker acknowledgment.
nodes.norm_label: restored exit paths retain overlap risk

nodes.label: DAS Hotkey Tools VS Code extension
nodes.description: Extension builds deterministic Hotkey.htk output from canonical metadata and scripts; same inputs produce same output. Header labels, Group tags and Ignore: True influence compilation.
nodes.norm_label: das hotkey tools vs code extension

nodes.label: Independent percentage-capped GTFO cushion
nodes.description: GTFO full-position signed exit uses min($0.50, quote*gtfoOffsetMaxPct), default 5%, 0 disables. Subtract from Bid long, add to Ask short; at $0.20 yields $0.19/$0.21. Round toward quote to retain cap and positive minimum; Last fallback if required quote unavailable. BESTL AUTOL urgent; manual gtfoRoute.

nodes.label: DAS Trader Pro desktop and chart configuration
nodes.description: Linked repository provides DAS Trader desktop/chart configuration.
nodes.norm_label: das trader pro desktop and chart configuration

nodes.label: Profitable scale-in and total planned-stop risk gate
nodes.description: Long adds require at least 1R profit, use Set Auto Stop BE Scale 1/1, and compare total post-add net planned-stop risk to the per-trade cap.
nodes.norm_label: profitable scale-in and total planned-stop risk gate
nodes.rationale: Adds are allowed only when the thesis is working and total planned-stop risk stays bounded.

nodes.label: Nested action lease and deferred automation
nodes.description: Nested action depth/until pauses timer work during cancellation/fill waits; alerts defer on their original trade. Lease expires after 30s for interruption recovery. Concurrent manual action logs retry; GTFO queues saved account/symbol and runs when the action ends.
nodes.norm_label: nested action lease and deferred automation

nodes.label: AUTOL has no fallback, retry or session gating
nodes.description: No route fallback/rejection retry/rerouting. Missing required quote blocks ordinary AUTOL submission. Operator monitors route window 04:00–20:00 ET; no clock conversion or session gate. Same bands regular/extended hours. Manual presets persist until reload or AUTOL selected.
nodes.norm_label: autol has no fallback, retry or session gating

nodes.label: Percentage ceiling on ordinary Bid- sells and Ask+ covers
nodes.description: Ordinary full/half/quarter Bid- sells and Ask+ covers use min(exitOffset, quote*exitOffsetMaxPct), default $0.10 and 5%; 0 disables cap. Sells subtract from Bid, covers add to Ask; final rounding stays within cap. Covers use four decimals below $0.25, native precision otherwise. Ask .4298→.451 and .1796→.1885. Does not guarantee broker acceptance/fill.
nodes.norm_label: percentage ceiling on ordinary bid- sells and ask+ covers

nodes.label: Six-state Stream Deck route selector
nodes.description: Page5 both profiles cycle AUTOL,FREE1L,BESTL,SMRTL,ARCA1L,FLSH1L; colors green, white/white/white, red/red. Requires local six-state Advanced Toggles. FLSH1L displays FLASH1L manual preset. Globals reset route AUTOL without directly updating deck display.

nodes.label: DAS Trader Scripts Discord community
nodes.description: README community link.

nodes.label: Direction-aware fixed-R STOP/SLP protection
nodes.description: RESET STOP LOSS uses signed size/average: long stop Avg-R, limit trigger-exitOffset; short stop Avg+R, limit trigger+exitOffset; flat none. Refresh after cancellation, abort flat/reversed/missing data. Short old-stop cancel must acknowledge before replacement. Native STOP/SLP route remains independent of orderRoute; uncapped exitOffset applies. R presets $0.10/$0.20/$0.30/$0.50.

nodes.label: DAS runtime and named window requirements
nodes.description: Requires Primary_OE montage, Primary_Chart synchronization chart, installed other scripts/timer.das and advanced scripting with AccountObj.GetPosition/NewUserObj. Target is DAS Trader Pro 5.8.4.4; execution requires separate SIM checks.
nodes.norm_label: das runtime and named window requirements

nodes.label: Exit coordinator rollback installation procedure
nodes.description: Rollback compares 100 public bindings and entry/exit logic to Hotkey-20261015-062456.htk while retaining the history-lookup correction. Documented installation is flat/no working orders, replaces map and timer, saves/restarts/initializes and checks a manual 10-share SIM position with one full exit.
nodes.rationale: Restart discards the old coordinator's queued session state.

nodes.label: Broker-dependent STOP/SLP extended-hours behavior
nodes.description: Scripts submit STOP/SLP. Whether broker/DAS behaves as LIMITP outside regular hours requires separate verification; LIMITP-tailored workflow is a documented consideration.
nodes.rationale: Thin liquidity and volatility can make outside-hours stop behavior consequential.

nodes.label: Documented global configuration defaults
nodes.description: Set Global Variables baseline: timer arming 1, entryMaxTicks 10, auto stop/TP Yes, resetStopOnCancel Yes, fixed R .50, TP factor1/size .50, risk cap $2000, poll100ms*20, inline cooldown1s, AUTOL, gtfoRoute FLSH1L, tier100/200/300/500 and qtyMult1; defaults include independent signed entry and exit-cap settings.

nodes.label: Versioned human-readable DAS scripts
nodes.description: Shared plain-text .das scripts, supporting scripts and canonical keymap.yaml make a large compiled hotkey library easier to review, version and share.
nodes.rationale: Human-readable source improves review and source control.

nodes.label: Timer-owned partial-exit fill and cancellation stages
nodes.description: TP and manual half/quarter exits always require timer. Initial cancellation waits remain TP=300ms, manual partial=100ms; after submission lease releases. Timer monitors actual position fills, cancels remainder at timeout, waits for open quantity zero, then sizes protection from fresh signed position/average. GTFO/full exits/cancel interrupt.
nodes.norm_label: timer-owned partial-exit fill and cancellation stages
nodes.rationale: Responsiveness improves by releasing the lease after send while real fills and cancellation closure determine remaining protection.

nodes.label: SIM/LIVE placeholder substitution
nodes.description: The extension substitutes %%SIMULATED%% and %%LIVE%% during build. Manual copying requires substitution in account/session scripts and setting $TRSIM/$LIVEACT to actual account IDs.

nodes.label: Every-second account/symbol timer runtime
nodes.description: Timer visits active account/symbol contexts for entry/exit staging, short protection, deferred actions and cleanup without switching montages. Pending exit suspends entry watch. Hijack work only when enabled. Compiler does not install timer; complete matching keymap/helpers and globals required.

nodes.label: Quote-based adding/taking prediction
nodes.description: Unchanged resolver classifies final adjusted/rounded limit: buy/cover below Ask or sell/short above Bid predicts adding; at/beyond opposite quote predicts taking. Expected taking price uses Ask for buy/cover and Bid for sell/short.
nodes.rationale: This predicts liquidity from quotes and is neither post-only behavior nor a guarantee of rebate, execution, acceptance or eventual classification.

nodes.label: Timer-based entry and partial-exit latency changes
nodes.description: Unreleased moves TP/manual partial fill monitoring to account/symbol timer, confirms residual closure before resizing, arms clean fresh long on first fill tick, removes inline 1s padding in favor of rollover-safe cooldown, adds position-only reads and skips disabled hijack checks.
nodes.norm_label: timer-based entry and partial-exit latency changes

nodes.label: Fresh signed account-position reads
nodes.description: Use GetAccountObj(account).GetPosition(symbol).Share including reserved shares. Routine polling reads position/average without quotes; pricing reads fresh quotes. Montage/native Pos are absolute and GetCurrPos may temporarily be zero. Missing data fails closed; montage fallback must match account/symbol.
nodes.rationale: Unknown or reserved-share data must not be mistaken for flat state or invented average cost.

nodes.label: SIM opt-in for enabled live-only guards
nodes.description: applyLiveGuardsToSim defaults 0; enabled hijack and rehab guards remain LIVE-only unless opted in. Hijack itself defaults disabled. Other guard rails apply both SIM/LIVE.
nodes.norm_label: sim opt-in for enabled live-only guards

nodes.label: Rehab entry throttle
nodes.description: rehab blocks scale-ins and limits live entries to MIB/IB. SIM only applies when applyLiveGuardsToSim=1. Toggle session setting or change/reload defaults; disabling requires typed YES.
nodes.rationale: Throttle sizing and additions while discipline resets after a drawdown.

nodes.label: One tracked automated long per account by default
nodes.description: singlePositionGuard=1 permits one tracked automated long per account; independent manual shorts do not occupy it. Off permits independent multiple longs. Other-symbol pending long/duplicate same-symbol buy blocks. Confirmed flat/short releases, unavailable data retains, montage changes preserve original trade.
nodes.norm_label: one tracked automated long per account by default

nodes.label: Client-side trade registry lifecycle
nodes.description: tradeStates registry and reusable tradeSlots hold per-account/symbol objects. Set Global Variables refreshes configuration/action lease while preserving initialized trades. Restart clears the registry; existing broker orders are not reconstructed.
nodes.rationale: Reload should preserve active state, while restart requires deliberate protection/alert restoration.

nodes.label: Inline polling and per-trade entry cooldown
nodes.description: useTimerArming=0 polls actual fills up to maxPolls*pollMs, accepts configured partials/cancels remainder, then protects actual shares. Former 1,000ms padding is removed. Per-account/symbol whole-second cooldown defaults 1s, 0 disables; retained through flat cleanup/reload and handles midnight.
nodes.norm_label: inline polling and per-trade entry cooldown

nodes.label: Offset short binding migration preserves script IDs
nodes.description: Ask Offset tiers1–4 use Alt+Ctrl+Shift+F1–F4 and Bid Offset tiers1–4 F5–F8. Labels and group comments say signed offset; stable *_minus ids/scriptPath remain.
nodes.norm_label: offset short binding migration preserves script ids

nodes.label: Green Bid and red Ask offset microchip backgrounds
nodes.description: BID icon is #00FF00 and ASK #FF0000 sampled from existing buy/sell profiles, both black interior/background. Plugin overlays label/value; same icon serves all five side states. Derived from blue microchip image via generation/edit then downscaled 156x160.
nodes.norm_label: green bid and red ask offset microchip backgrounds
nodes.rationale: Preserve the established chip geometry and dark background while using exact side colors; values and labels stay separate.

nodes.label: Stream Deck controls and DAS settings synchronization
nodes.description: Both physical/Virtual profiles use ASK±/BID± for offset buys page 2 and shorts page 4. Independent green BID and red ASK five-state selectors exist on settings page 5 only, column 6 rows 1/2, Toggle Groups 3/4. Both ordered lists -0.03,-0.02,-0.01,+0.01,+0.03. LOAD CFG restores BID+0.01/ASK-0.01 displays and globals; direct variable/globals edits do not synchronize display.
nodes.norm_label: stream deck controls and das settings synchronization

nodes.label: Canonical groups and retained script identities
nodes.description: Canonical metadata groups global controls, buy Ask/Bid plain/offsets, short Ask/Bid plain/signed offsets, covers, sells, stops, TP and utilities. Stable ids/scriptPath keep legacy buy_25/buy_50 and short *_minus filenames while user labels describe current tiers/offsets.
nodes.norm_label: canonical groups and retained script identities

nodes.label: Fixed Momo internal swap binding
nodes.description: Comment and metadata preserve Momo Swap Internal at Ctrl+Shift+F12 with swap_internal id/path.

nodes.label: Precise Stream Deck microchip recolor specification
nodes.description: Documented edit prompts preserve original geometry, strokes, rounded corners, pins, margins, empty interior, antialiasing and 78:80 aspect, replacing only blue with exact green/red. No text, glow, shadows, gradients or added elements.
nodes.norm_label: precise stream deck microchip recolor specification

nodes.label: DAS script header metadata
nodes.description: First comment lines contain script label, Group and optional Ignore: True. Group names align with keymap section headers; ignored scripts are excluded from builds.

nodes.label: In-memory regression versus DAS qualification
nodes.description: node tools/tests/trade-isolation.test.cjs models DAS source decisions against signed positions, orders, alerts and montage changes in memory. It does not connect to DAS, send orders, or validate broker execution. Review in SIM with actual routes, sizes and guards.

nodes.label: Momo-coordinated two-montage symbol swap
nodes.description: swap_internal.das bound Ctrl+Shift+F12 swaps Primary_OE/Secondary_OE symbols then updates primary/secondary charts and Secondary_TS after saving both symbols. Momo primary montage trading performs flat/pending/setup checks before fixed internal shortcut; user requests through Momo Swap. Optional request_swap.cmd ShellExec helper stays in Momo. Layout/live qualification remains unpassed.

nodes.norm_label: red rounded-square outline with outward pins on all four sides

nodes.norm_label: green microchip icon on black background

nodes.norm_label: bright green microchip outline with perimeter pins

nodes.label: Manual buy guard diagnostics and configuration display
nodes.description: testMode=1 runs buy non-market guard checks without sending orders; reset to0 or run globals afterward. Dedicated test toggle hotkeys/buttons removed. Show Config exposes runtime settings and read-only Primary_OE Pos/GetCurrPos diagnostics.
nodes.norm_label: manual buy guard diagnostics and configuration display

nodes.label: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F1-F8 short offset bindings
nodes.description: Alt+Ctrl+Shift+F1–F4 map Ask Offset Tiers 1–4; F5–F8 Bid Offset Tiers 1–4. Legacy script filenames/IDs and all five size states remain.
nodes.rationale: Removing Windows-key combinations avoids the reported Explorer-window conflict.

nodes.label: Quote plus signed offset for buys and shorts
nodes.description: Bid+ and Ask+ buy scripts already add signed offsets. Eight short offset scripts now also add selected signed offset to quote, preserving legacy *_minus filenames/IDs. Negative is below quote, positive above; defaults ASK-0.01 below Ask and BID+0.01 above Bid. Reject nonpositive adjusted/rounded short limit; log reference quote, signed offset and submitted limit.
nodes.norm_label: quote plus signed offset for buys and shorts

nodes.label: Direction-aware native Reverse covers
nodes.description: Full/half/quarter covers use native Reverse, reduce shorts via buy or longs via sell, cancel existing orders first. Partial sizes floor whole shares, min 1, max current size, abort flat/account-symbol changes. Ask+ uses capped independent exit cushion; Bid plain. Older orders may race cancellation and limit orders may remain unfilled.

nodes.label: Plain and offset manual short entries
nodes.description: Plain Ask/Bid Tier 1–4 shorts on page 3 use selected quote; offset variants on page 4 use signed quote addition. All send explicit sell-short DAY+ using rounded tier*multiplier, accept flat/add-short and reject existing long/unsafe direction. They bypass long guards and arm enabled timer stop/TP after actual fills.
nodes.norm_label: plain and offset manual short entries

nodes.label: Signed entry-offset correction and shell-safe short bindings
nodes.description: Unreleased correction changes eight offset-short scripts to quote+signed offset, retains correct buys/routing, labels both decks ASK±/BID±, moves offset shorts to Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F1–F8, leaves five-choice selectors on page5 only, logs quote/offset/limit and rejects rounded-zero shorts.
nodes.norm_label: signed entry-offset correction and shell-safe short bindings
nodes.rationale: Negative offsets must be below the selected quote and positive offsets above for both trade directions.

nodes.label: Full-position bidirectional breakeven protection
nodes.description: Full BE supports long/short; half and scale-in BE remain long-only. Short normal BE buy-stop trigger is Avg-.03 and limit Avg; if Ask above trigger use buy limit Avg, optionally lower Ask under pegToBid. Documentation says BE can work with auto stops disabled.
nodes.documentation_ambiguity: L539-L540 states BE scripts do not check useAutoStop and work while automatic stops are disabled; L548-L549 states the variants honor useAutoStop. This wording does not establish one consistent gating rule for all BE variants; current DAS source must decide.

nodes.label: Pending-refresh accounting requirement
nodes.description: Check pending-refresh.json. Clear an entry only after that file is actually re-extracted and merged; retain existing graph and record changed files when a full refresh is outside scope.

nodes.label: Current-source verification of graph claims
nodes.description: Compare built_at_commit to HEAD and inspect working-tree scripts, bindings, tests, docs, and assets. Matching commits alone are insufficient. Stale graphs are navigation hints; current source and instructions take precedence.

nodes.label: Graph vocabulary and path direction rules
nodes.description: Expand unfamiliar wording against actual graph labels; use path and explain. Use --undirected when dependency direction is intentionally ignored; a missing directed path does not disprove a relationship.
nodes.norm_label: graph vocabulary and path direction rules

nodes.label: Graphify query-first investigation workflow
nodes.description: Follow the installed skill for /graphify. Query existing graphs before implementation investigations; use scoped results for current-source inspection. Navigate wiki/report as needed; use graph traversal or targeted inspection when graph access fails.
nodes.rationale: Existing graph context should scope investigation without blocking authorized work.

nodes.label: Graph maintenance operational boundary
nodes.description: Graph maintenance does not authorize compiling/installing hotkeys, modifying Stream Deck profiles, or operating the trading application.

nodes.label: Graph and regression evidence limitations
nodes.description: Keep EXTRACTED, INFERRED and AMBIGUOUS distinct. An undirected path establishes neither call direction nor runtime reachability. Dependencies and in-memory checks do not prove installed DAS behavior, broker acceptance, execution or fills.

nodes.label: Source-only DAS hotkey workflow
nodes.description: Make and validate repository source changes; compiling/loading hotkeys and changing active DAS hotkey configuration require an explicit user request.
nodes.rationale: The user owns compilation and installation.

nodes.label: Refresh integrity and provenance requirements
nodes.description: Preserve locations, parallel-edge evidence and integrity checks; update extraction manifest/cache only for processed files. Record true provenance, unavailable token usage, and stale/unindexed scope. Extend incompatible adapters before replacing a useful DAS graph.

nodes.label: DAS-aware extraction and merge requirement
nodes.description: The standard parser does not recognize .das. Use the project DAS adapter for literal ExecHotkey/keymap/shared-state evidence, fresh test-code extraction and semantic docs/images, replacing obsolete changed/deleted-file evidence while preserving unrelated evidence and ignored vendor PDFs.

nodes.label: Retained-evidence builder limitation
nodes.description: build_project_graph.py renders extraction-evidence.json; it performs neither fresh extraction nor automatic DAS-result merging.
nodes.rationale: Running only the adapter and builder does not complete a refresh.
